title: Fuglede--Kadison Determinants of Shifted Matrix Semicircles
summary: We prove a variational formula for the Fuglede-Kadison determinant of a self-adjoint matrix semicircle $S_a = a \otimes 1 + \sum_j A_j \otimes s_j$ with deterministic mean $a$. For every real $z$, $\log Δ(S_a - z) = -1/2 + \inf_b F_z(b)$, where the infimum is over positive definite matrices $b$ such that the map $X \mapsto bXb - \sum_j A_j X A_j$ is positive semidefinite, and $F_z$ is an explicit geodesically convex function.
